They are beautiful enchanted creatures appearing at noon, brushing their hair in the sunshine or bathing in a brook. They may guard treasure or haunt castles, and entreat mortals to break their spell, always unsuccessfully. Jacob Grimm traced their whiteness and sunlight to the light elves (Ljósálfar) living in Álfheim under the god Freyr.
